Issue.description:
Missing or bad metadata that should be fixed in the source files. Which
`details` are set depends on the `code`:

- `artwork_missing`: no artwork found by any of the fetchers
- `artwork_not_square`: the found artwork is not a perfect square
- `artwork_low_res`: the found artwork is of low quality
- `album_missing`: tracks without an album tag ("Unknown Album")
- `release_year_missing`: the album has no release year
- `track_number_missing`: `trackIds` of the tracks without a track number
- `track_number_duplicate`: `numbers` used by more than one track on `disc`
- `track_number_gap`: `numbers` missing on `disc`, possibly incomplete album?
- `title_missing`: `trackIds` of the tracks without a title tag
- `artist_missing`: the track has no artist at all (invisible in library)

info.description:
## Authentication
All requests require a bearer token in the `Authorization` header,
however it is also possible to generate a `playToken` that temporarily
lets you access track downloads/streams. This is mostly intended to be
used by clients that cannot add the `Authorization` header to their
audio player requests (like a native `<audio>` tag in HTML).

get.description:
This generally helps provide the best experience for end-users by syncing
the metadata to be available offline and use local database techniques when
displaying, sorting, searching, etc. in the library.

The initial sync can take a couple of requests before it is completed,
depending on the size of your library. But if you store the last returned
`cursor` from then on sync requests should only return new changes.

If you want to also sync the actual tracks this is something you would have
to manage in your application by building a download queue and keeping track
of the download status etc.

## Random sort and pagination

When `sort_by=random`, the server uses the provided `random_seed` to
maintain consistent ordering across paginated requests. This should be a
non-negative integer.

For `sort_by=default` (or omitted), `random_seed` is ignored.
